# Starfield collision payload locations — discovery result (2026-08-10, plan task 6).
#
# WHERE STARFIELD COLLISION LIVES
#   Inside the .nif itself, exactly as FO76 does. A collision-bearing Starfield
#   NIF carries a `bhkPhysicsSystem` block whose "Binary Data" byte array is a
#   self-contained Havok TAG0 tagfile. It is NOT in the external `.mesh`
#   geometry files: 6,000 files under extracted/starfield/geometries/ were
#   scanned for the TAG0 magic and produced zero hits. LOD NIFs under
#   meshes/lod/ likewise carry none (500 scanned, zero hits).
#
#   Locating the payload in a NIF: find the ASCII magic `TAG0`; the tagfile
#   starts 4 bytes earlier, at the HFF section header — a big-endian u32 whose
#   low 30 bits are the total tagfile size and whose top 2 bits are the section
#   scope. Immediately before that header sits the NIF byte-array length as a
#   little-endian u32. A NIF may hold more than one payload (14 of 2,694
#   sampled NIFs had two; cloth/banner assets).
#
#   Coverage over 2,694 NIFs spanning architecture, landscape, setdressing,
#   furniture, items, plants, outpost, ships, actors, effects, space and
#   starstations: 2,168 carry a payload (80.5%), yielding 2,182 tagfiles.
#
# FORMAT DELTA vs FO76
#   Every sampled payload reports SDKV `20190200` (Havok 2019.2.0); FO76 is
#   `20150100`. The 2018+ SDK renamed the type sections: TST1/FST1/TNA1/TBDY
#   where FO76 writes TSTR/FSTR/TNAM/TBOD. The tagfile body encoding is
#   otherwise unchanged, so the reflective TAG0 reader handles both once the
#   section names are accepted.
#
# SHAPE-CLASS CENSUS (2,182 payloads, instance counts)
#   hknpConvexShape           5197
#   hknpShapeMassProperties   5077
#   hknpCompressedMeshShape   1291  (+1291 hknpCompressedMeshShapeData)
#   hknpCompoundShape          665
#   hknpBoxShape               644
#   hknpLodShape               596
#   hknpCapsuleShape           434  (concentrated in actors/ ragdolls)
#   hknpSphereShape            115
#   hknpCylinderShape           20
#   hknpTriangleShape            5
#
# Format below: <nif-path>|<tagfile-byte-offset>|<tagfile-byte-length>|<label>
# Paths are relative to STARFIELD_EXTRACTED_DIR. Tests skip cleanly when that
# directory and the repository-local extracted data tree are absent.
